completenessNote: 全文，共 6 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. These Regulations are the Info-communications Media Development Authority (Saving and Transitional Provisions) Regulations 2016 and come into operation on 1 October 2016.

3.—(1) The Section 16 Notification remains in force and is deemed to have been made by the Minister under the definition of “regulated person” in section 2 of the IMDA Act.
(2) The references to section 16(3)(a)(i) and (ii) of the Media Development Authority of Singapore Act in the Schedule to the Section 16 Notification are to be taken as references to paragraph (b) of the definition of “regulated person” in section 2 of the IMDA Act.
(3) The references to section 16(3)(b) of the Media Development Authority of Singapore Act in the Schedule to the Section 16 Notification are to be taken as references to paragraph (a) of the definition of “regulated person” in section 2 of the IMDA Act.

4.—(1) The Section 21 Notification remains in force and is deemed to have been made by the Authority under section 63(3)(b) of the IMDA Act.
(2) The reference to section 21 of the Media Development Authority of Singapore Act in paragraph 2 of the Section 21(4) Notification is to be taken as a reference to section 63 of the IMDA Act.
(3) The reference to section 16(3) of the Media Development Authority of Singapore Act in paragraph 2(b) of the Section 21(4) Notification is to be taken as a reference to the definition of “regulated person” in section 2 of the IMDA Act.

heading.en: Appointment of transferred MDA employee under principal Act

text.en:
5.—(1) This regulation applies to a transferred MDA employee who, immediately before the appointed date, holds any appointment under a principal Act.
(2) The transferred MDA employee’s appointment under the principal Act continues until —
(a)the appointment is revoked under that Act;
(b)the term of the appointment expires; or
(c)the employee vacates his or her office, for any reason, before the expiry of the term of the appointment.

heading.en: Appointment of transferred IDA employee under principal Act

text.en:
6.—(1) This regulation applies to a transferred IDA employee —
(a)who, immediately before the appointed date, holds any appointment under a principal Act; and
(b)whose function under that Act is a transferred IDA function.
(2) The transferred IDA employee’s appointment under the principal Act continues until —
(a)the appointment is revoked under that Act;
(b)the term of the appointment expires; or
(c)the employee vacates his or her office, for any reason, before the expiry of the term of the appointment.
